newsitem.title: USA: Calif. treasurer sells $16 mln university bonds.
newsitem.headline: Calif. treasurer sells $16 mln university bonds.

text.p: California state Treasurer Matt Fong on Wednesday said he sold about $16 million of bonds for two Southern California state universities.
Fong sold $9.6 million of refunding revenue bonds for the California State University, Fullerton campus, to refinance outstanding debt.
Another $6.6 million of revenue bonds was sold to fund the construction of a student union building at the California State University, Los Angeles campus.
The bonds were given the highest bond ratings by both Standard & Poor's Corp and Moody's Investors Service Inc because they were insured by AMBAC Inc.
